violations.description: Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager * had an expired certificate or is no longer associated with this establishment. . ServeSafe Expired
Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage * was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. . Refrigerator was 45*F

Hot storage of potentially hazardous food. — --Hot food storage facilities/equipment * was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining temperature of potentially hazardous food at 140F or greater. . Pizzas Rack 119*F

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment * that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. . Ice machine need to be cleaned.
Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not placed in a self-draining position. Mop heads were not inverted or place in a way to allow mop to dry.
General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Employee went from working register to take food off grill with bare hands without handwashing.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Ice Machine had residue build up inside/around ice chute.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Vents in kitchen area ceiling contained build up of dust.

Lighting. — --Lighting did not have protective shielding in areas where there is exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, or unwrapped single-service items. Light in walk in cooler does not have a shield.
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (2 pts deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (2 pts deducted)
